annotation.title_clean: ロボット介護機器実証試験ガイドライン 第2版
annotation.title_en: Guidelines for Demonstration Testing of Robotic Care Devices, 2nd Edition
annotation.authors_or_issuer: AMED ロボット介護機器開発・標準化事業 基準策定・標準化コンソーシアム
annotation.venue: AMED Robotic Care Device Development and Standardization Project
named_instruments_referenced: Japan Act on the Protection of Personal Information
annotation.summary_en: Japanese AMED guideline (2nd edition, 2021) for demonstration testing of robotic care devices. It sets a V-model development process, ICF-based evaluation of effects on care recipients and caregivers, staged testing, safety assurance, risk assessment, ethics review, and templates for a development concept sheet and test plan.
key_provisions_or_claims: Evaluate robotic care devices by their effects on people (care recipients and caregivers) using the WHO ICF framework, focusing on 'activities actually performed'.
Use a V-model development process pairing target human activities with mechanical requirement definitions.
Stage tests from document verification to simulated operation, then 'can-do' and 'actually-do' activity tests, for safety.
Require risk assessment, indications and contraindications, and accident/incident response systems before human trials.
Require ethics review, informed consent, personal data protection and registration/publication of results to avoid bias.
